landmarks.flavor_en: The big baroque palace on the Schlossplatz.
The old castle with round towers and an arcaded courtyard.
The church with two different towers.
The big square with the Jubilee Column and fountains.
A long building with a row of columns along the square.
The opera house by the lake in the palace garden.
The station tower with the spinning Mercedes star on top.
